maddeler.e:
تصادمت (form VI)
# تَصَادَمْتُ (taṣādamtu) /ta.sˤaː.dam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# تَصَادَمْتَ (taṣādamta) /ta.sˤaː.dam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# تَصَادَمْتِ (taṣādamti) /ta.sˤaː.dam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# تَصَادَمَتْ (taṣādamat) /ta.sˤaː.da.mat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
